validation_notes: Processed 11 people for ticker NLMK: 1 CEO and 10 other CSV people. Checked 2 local NLMK documents: the 2024 annual report and the 2024 disclosed consolidated financial statements. Research notes saved for 11 people; one research round per person was performed. The local 2024 annual report confirms governance structure and that a nine-person board was elected on 14 May 2024, but it does not list individual board names; board identities for the six CSV board members therefore rely on CSV, MarketScreener and older official NLMK annual-report biographies. Education was found for all 11 people. Weak-source use remains for Nikolay Ivanov and Ben de Vos education/current-role detail where MarketScreener is the main opened source. Excluded namesakes include unrelated medical/academic Nikolay Ivanov profiles, unrelated Dmitry Kholkin mentions, academic author-only Stanislav Shekshnia matches without NLMK board context, and common Vladimir Lisin media duplicates. No verified h-index was added for any person. Remaining conflict: local 2024 report says the full board had nine members, while the CSV contains six board members; the pipeline output intentionally includes only CSV people as instructed. Search considered complete because local documents were checked first, official appointment sources were found for the CEO and key technology executives, board education/career facts were verified from an official NLMK annual report, obvious namesakes were rejected, and follow-up searches for education, prior employers, appointments, publications, patents and h-index did not produce higher-quality additional sources for the remaining gaps. QUALITY PASS ROUND 1 (2026-07-30): confirmed on-disk file already matched git HEAD exactly, no regression to restore. Fixed one simple desync: Ben de Vos University of Pretoria qualification_degree was null despite the description already stating a bachelor and a master degree; set to Master's degree, matching the same combined-degree convention already used for Irene Spitzberg/Michigan State in this file. Corrected two wrong GICS labels: Dmitry Kholkin/X5 Retail Group was Consumer Discretionary/Broadline Retail, but X5 is Russia's largest food retailer (confirmed via Wikipedia), corrected to Consumer Staples/Consumer Staples Distribution & Retail (New Name); Stanislav Shekshnia's aggregated Ward Howell/Alfa-Telecom/VimpelCom row was Communication Services/Diversified Telecommunication Services, but Ward Howell (named first) is an executive-search and leadership-consulting firm (confirmed via wardhowell.com), not telecom, so this aggregate row was nulled out, consistent with the same aggregate-row precedent already documented in gics_quality_round_20260728.md for Karataev's PwC/Russian Standard Bank/Nomura row. Filled seven genuine single-employer GICS gaps, each confirmed this round via a fresh source: Karataev/Freight One to Industrials/Transportation/Ground Transportation (New Name); Kholkin/Tele2 Russia and Ivanov/VimpelCom to Communication Services/Telecommunication Services/Wireless Telecommunication Services; Spitzberg/General Motors to Consumer Discretionary/Automobiles & Components/Automobiles; Spitzberg/Magna International-Magna Steyr to Consumer Discretionary/Automobiles & Components/Automobile Components (New Name); Gagarin/Yakovlev & Partners to Industrials/Commercial & Professional Services/Professional Services, based on the already-cited NLMK Annual Report 2019 source which the round-1 notes already describe as a senior legal-services leader. Deliberately left null and unchanged: Ivanov's combined EVRAZ / Raspadskaya row, because EVRAZ is Metals & Mining but Raspadskaya is specifically a coal producer and a single blended label risks exactly the coal-versus-metals-mining error this pass is meant to catch; Lisin's Karaganda Steel Plant/TulaChermet/Trans-CIS Commodities row and Veraszto's Emerging-markets investment and advisory roles row were reviewed and kept as-is because they are not clearly wrong; Karataev's PwC/Russian Standard Bank/Nomura row and Shekshnia's INSEAD row remain correctly null (aggregate/academic entities). One item flagged unresolved rather than silently changed: a fresh re-check of the already-cited Kommersant source (doc/5101384) while researching Karataev's Finance Academy graduation year returned text describing a 2000 graduation with a finance-and-credit specialty plus a materially different career narrative (Rostselmash, Novartis Basel, Fletcher Group) than the TPG Capital/PwC/Russian Standard Bank/Nomura narrative already in this file; this could not be independently corroborated within this round's bounded budget, so the existing already-vetted JSON content was left unchanged and this is flagged for a dedicated future round with direct primary-source verification rather than resolved either way. Bounded gap follow-up attempted and still unresolved: Ivanov/Northeast Missouri State University qualification_degree and year; Bagrin/University of Cambridge MBA year; Limberg/University of Dortmund graduation year; de Vos exact degree years -- fresh queries tried and sources checked are logged in research_notes/NLMK/quality_pass_round1_20260730.md.
